name: Discharge Clearance Report
query:
SELECT
    dac.name AS "Document:Link/Discharge And Clearance:180",
    DATE(dac.creation) AS "Date:Date:110",
    dac.patient AS "Patient:Link/Patient:180",
    dac.patient_name AS "Patient Name:Data:220",
    dac.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:180",
    dac.patient_balance AS "Patient Balance:Currency:140",
    dac.reason AS "Reason:Data:400"
FROM
    `tabDischarge And Clearance` dac
WHERE
    DATE(dac.creation) BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
ORDER BY
    dac.creation DESC;
